name: vcclient-forge
description: VCClient Forge - Task Runner and Integration

scripts.start: uv run --project backend python backend/main.py server
scripts.dev:backend: uv run --project backend python backend/main.py server
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend --
scripts.lint: uv run --project backend ruff check backend
scripts.lint:fix: uv run --project backend ruff check --fix backend
scripts.format: uv run --project backend ruff format backend
scripts.format:check: uv run --project backend ruff format --check backend
